freeze_boundary: Defined before opening the final v2 full-episode camera/robot outputs. No thresholds are adjusted from their results.
scope: Every saved 20 ms robot pose; camera visual OBBs versus actual official robot visual triangle surfaces from the exported composed scene. This is neither native collision geometry nor a rigid-contact acceptance test.
attachment_rule: Only a Bracket OBB against its exact own parent panda_hand body is an intentional attachment. Its intersections are still counted. Fingers, other links, and every Housing pair are tested without that exception.
surface_interpretation: Zero triangle intersections establishes only the sampled visual-surface test. Closed-volume containment, minimum exact mesh distance, continuous swept collision, native contacts, and camera mass/inertia are not measured here.
existing_obstacle_protocol: configs/wrist_camera_audit_v1.json independently checks conservative camera bounds against table, fixtures and knife.
